query:
UPDATE user_settings SET
            filter_prediction = COALESCE($2, filter_prediction),
            score_threshold = COALESCE($3, score_threshold),
            use_clusters = COALESCE($4, use_clusters),
            filter_mode = COALESCE($5, filter_mode),
            top_per_day = COALESCE($6, top_per_day),
            all_articles_top = COALESCE($7, all_articles_top),
            reader_layout = COALESCE($8, reader_layout),
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE user_id = $1
